She smiles broadly, looking around at the falling snow with a joyful expression. In the corners of the frame, white text overlays identify the theme, location, and date. The background consists of blurred city structures and trees. (2) A sharp cut shows a close-up of pine tree branches laden with thick, fresh white snow. The branches sway slightly against a modern grey building under a flat, overcast sky. (3) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman standing still, looking upwards at the sky with a serene smile. Snowflakes are clearly visible on her dark hair and the texture of her red sweater. (4) A tracking follow shot from behind captures her walking away along a path lined with snow-dusted greenery. She turns her head back to the camera, laughing silently as her hair blows in the cold wind. (5) Several close-up shots emphasize the woman's facial features and peaceful expressions as she looks directly into the lens or gazes off-screen. The soft, natural daylight highlights the contrast between the warm red of her clothing and the cold, white surroundings. (6) The video concludes as the scene fades to a black screen where white text repeats the summary information: 'A Snowfall', 'KOREA', 'SEOUL', and 'January 2024'.
